expected_dialogue.speaker: 老人
expected_dialogue.text: 每人只算一次。痕永不消，能一直添。

expected_camera.cn: 0–3秒买鞘时间省略，系鞘已完成，锥滑入；3秒以麻绳旧柄纹理匹配切三个月前废船，冷色与角标明确。3–10秒闪回连续近中景，余烬入旧胸伤、盒碎、老人覆锥手讲话。10秒台词落点匹配切到傍晚屋内包扎右手收拢钱袋的近景，随后在10–13秒内后拉侧移，陆照将钱倒在歪桌。10–30秒家中一镜到底：从这只包扎手跟钱落歪桌，侧移见姐姐换碗，推近两碗分肉，再随纸摊桌缓俯拍船图价格与200铜，抬至姐弟说话收钱，最后手、两碗、纸和袋同框。
expected_camera.en: At 0s show the already-purchased sheath tied at the waist and slide the original awl into it over three seconds. At 3s match-cut on the old hemp handle texture to the abandoned-boat flashback, cooler light and the clear time caption three months earlier. From 3s to 10s use a continuous intimate medium-close view for the ember entering the old chest wound, box breaking and elder hand over the awl hand during his speech. At 10s match-cut on the elder final syllable to a close view of Lu Zhao bandaged RIGHT hand gathering the coin purse inside the dusk home. Within 10–13s pull back and slide as he pours the tied coin strings onto the crooked table. From 10s to 30s maintain this same continuous domestic take: follow the coin strings onto the crooked table, slide sideways as the sister replaces the chipped bowl, move nearer as meat is shared, gently tilt down when the boat paper is spread beside both bowls and the two-hundred-copper strings, then rise toward their faces while Lu Zhao speaks and gathers the money. End on hands, intact bowls, paper and purse together.

action_cn.start: 时间省略到买鞘后：新皮鞘已系腰，付过的铜钱留在摊布上，陆照手握原锥
action_cn.beat: 原锥滑入新鞘，旧麻绳锥柄停在鞘口
action_cn.end: 锥柄纹路接到回忆里的同一锥柄

expected_beats.action_en: After the sheath purchase time cut, the new sheath is already fastened to Lu Zhao's belt, paid coins rest on the stall cloth and the original awl is in his hand. Then he slides it into the sheath; its old wrapped handle match-cuts to the same handle in memory.
expected_beats.continuity_out: 锥柄纹路接到回忆里的同一锥柄

action_cn.start: 暖色变冷，角标“三个月前”；消瘦无须老人右腕缠红布，陆照衣襟有旧伤血
action_cn.beat: 老人将赤红薄物压入陆照胸前伤处
action_cn.end: 盒壳烧碎，红光收进胸骨

expected_beats.action_en: Flashback color shifts cool with a post-composited three-months-earlier caption. A gaunt clean-shaven elder wearing a red wrist strip presses a thin ember into an old wound on Lu Zhao's chest. Then the casing crumbles to ash as the red glow settles beneath his sternum.
expected_beats.continuity_out: 盒壳烧碎，红光收进胸骨

action_cn.start: 老人手覆在陆照握锥的手上，胸口余光已暗
action_cn.beat: 老人说完半句喘气，再抓紧一下指节
action_cn.end: 声音落下时，切回包扎手收住钱袋

expected_beats.action_en: The gaunt elder's hand rests on Lu Zhao's awl hand as the chest glow fades. Then he speaks, pauses for breath and tightens his fingers once; his final words bridge to Lu Zhao's present-day bandaged hand closing the purse.

lines.speaker: 老人
lines.text: 每人只算一次。痕永不消，能一直添。

expected_beats.continuity_out: 声音落下时，切回包扎手收住钱袋

action_cn.start: 傍晚，陆照进窄屋，将剩下的几串铜钱倒在歪桌上，付过饭宿的纸票夹在袋边
action_cn.beat: 一串钱滑向低处，他用包扎手按住桌角
action_cn.end: 陆禾从灶边回身，闻到湿衣味，目光停在手上的布

expected_beats.action_en: At dusk Lu Zhao enters the cramped room and tips his remaining tied coin strings onto the crooked table; a paid lodging slip sits at his purse edge. Then one string slides toward the low edge; he braces the table with his bandaged hand as Lu He turns from the stove and notices his damp clothes and dressing.
expected_beats.continuity_out: 陆禾从灶边回身，闻到湿衣味，目光停在手上的布

action_cn.start: 陆照伸手拿缺口碗，陆禾先收走它
action_cn.beat: 她把盛着热饭的完整碗塞进他包扎的掌心，往饭上拨一块肉
action_cn.end: 陆照望着碗沿，喉头动了一下才坐下

expected_beats.action_en: Lu Zhao reaches for a chipped bowl, but Lu He takes it away first. Then she places a whole bowl of hot rice into his bandaged palm and adds a piece of meat. He studies its unbroken rim, swallows and sits down.
expected_beats.continuity_out: 陆照望着碗沿，喉头动了一下才坐下

action_cn.start: 完整碗的热气升起，陆照夹住那块肉
action_cn.beat: 他把肉分开，将半块放回姐姐碗中
action_cn.end: 陆禾低头吃那半块，眼睛亮了一下

expected_beats.action_en: Steam rises from the whole bowl. Then Lu Zhao divides the meat and places half into his sister's bowl; Lu He lowers her head to eat it, with a brief brightness in her eyes.
expected_beats.continuity_out: 陆禾低头吃那半块，眼睛亮了一下

action_cn.start: 陆禾把青蟹号售船纸摊在两只碗旁；船头旧补丁图与价格“三千铜”清楚
action_cn.beat: 陆照指尖认出图上的补丁，陆禾按住另一角
action_cn.end: 姐弟都看向桌上刚挣回的二百铜

expected_beats.action_en: Lu He unfolds the sale notice for the Blue Crab beside their two bowls; a familiar repaired bow and the post-composited three-thousand-copper price are visible. Then Lu Zhao touches the patch in the drawing while she holds the opposite corner, and both look toward the two hundred coins on the table.

on_screen_text.text:
青蟹号
售价 三千铜

expected_beats.continuity_out: 姐弟都看向桌上刚挣回的二百铜

action_cn.start: 陆照把桌上已经串好的钱收进袋，放到售船纸旁
action_cn.beat: 他看着姐姐说“我们挣”，陆禾伸手按住纸的另一角
action_cn.end: 两人的手停在各自的完整碗边，钱袋留在纸旁

expected_beats.action_en: Lu Zhao gathers the already tied coin strings into the purse beside the boat notice. Then he looks at his sister and speaks; Lu He holds the opposite corner of the paper, their hands resting by their whole bowls with the purse beside the notice.
expected_beats.continuity_out: 两人的手停在各自的完整碗边，钱袋留在纸旁
